title: Check Ignition Gateway system performance status via localhost sys.perf page
summary: Use the Ignition Gateway web UI on the host to open the system performance status page at http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf. Confirm the page loads and that system performance/health indicators are visible (not a connection/refused/unreachable error).
when_to_use: When Ignition Gateway reachability or performance is suspected on the Ignition Gateway host, and you need a quick local check that the /web/status/sys.perf page is reachable and shows performance/health indicators.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Perform the local Ignition Gateway sys.perf page check (reachability + visible performance/health indicators) and escalate for deeper gateway diagnostics if the page is unreachable or indicates unhealthy/degraded status.
access_or_tools_needed: Web browser access to the Ignition Gateway host

access_required: L2_support access to the Ignition Gateway host (local browser access)
system_preconditions: Ignition Gateway is expected to be reachable locally on port 8088

visual_references.description: Frame showing Ignition Gateway UI accessed via browser at http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf (sys.perf path visible).

steps.title: Open the Ignition Gateway sys.perf status page on localhost
steps.purpose: Verify Ignition Gateway is reachable locally and that the sys.perf status page can be loaded.
steps.instruction: On the Ignition Gateway host, open a web browser and navigate to http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf.
steps.expected_result: The browser successfully loads the Ignition Gateway system performance status page at /web/status/sys.perf (page content visible; not a connection/refused/unreachable error).
steps.healthy_condition: The sys.perf page loads with visible page content rather than an unreachable/error state.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not load, or the browser shows an obvious unreachable/error state (e.g., connection refused/unreachable).
stop_or_escalate_if: If http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf does not load (connection refused/unreachable), treat Ignition Gateway as not healthy/reachable and escalate for deeper gateway diagnostics.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows Ignition Gateway UI accessible via web browser at http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf.
Frame shows Ignition Gateway UI and the localhost sys.perf URL.

steps.title: Verify sys.perf performance/health indicators are visible
steps.purpose: Assess whether the gateway is performing acceptably based on the visible performance/health indicators on the sys.perf page.
steps.instruction: On the loaded /web/status/sys.perf page, observe the system performance status indicators/readouts shown on the page.
steps.expected_result: System performance/health information is displayed on the sys.perf page (not blank and not replaced by an error/unavailable state).
steps.healthy_condition: Performance/health indicators/readouts are visible on the sys.perf page.
steps.failure_condition: The page loads but the performance indicators show degraded/unacceptable status (as indicated by the sys.perf performance/health readouts).

actions.label: Observe performance indicators
actions.exact_action: Observe the system performance status indicators shown on the sys.perf page

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page loads but performance indicators show degraded/unacceptable status, escalate for deeper Ignition Gateway performance investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate notes indicate that after loading /web/status/sys.perf, you should observe performance/health readouts on the page.

success_criteria: http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf loads successfully in a browser
The sys.perf page displays system performance/health indicators (no connection/refused/unreachable error)
healthy_conditions: sys.perf page content is visible (page loads successfully)
Performance/health indicators/readouts are present and not indicating degraded/unacceptable status
failure_conditions: sys.perf page does not load due to unreachable/error state (e.g., connection refused/unreachable)
sys.perf page loads but performance indicators show degraded/unacceptable status
escalation_guidance: If the sys.perf page is unreachable/error: treat Ignition Gateway as not healthy/reachable and escalate for deeper gateway diagnostics.
If the sys.perf page loads but indicators show degraded/unacceptable status: escalate for deeper Ignition Gateway performance investigation.
